description: This file is a PHP script that implements a search page for an e-commerce website. It handles user session management, processes search input to fetch products from a database, and displays the search results with options to view details, add to wishlist, or add to cart.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Executes the prepared statement to retrieve matching products from the database.

methods.name: fetch()
methods.description: Fetches the next row from the result set as an associative array.
